description: Defines the MojoDecryptor class, a Decryptor implementation using Mojo IPC for media decryption, including method declarations, member variables, and external dependencies.

classes.name: MojoDecryptor
classes.description: A final class implementing the Decryptor interface, utilizing Mojo IPC to perform media decryption tasks, managing Mojo remote connections, buffer reading/writing, and thread safety.

methods.name: MojoDecryptor
methods.description: Constructor initializing MojoDecryptor with a Mojo remote and optional writer capacity.

methods.name: Decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted media stream asynchronously.

methods.name: CancelDecrypt
methods.description: Cancels ongoing decryption for a given stream type.

methods.name: InitializeAudioDecoder
methods.description: Initializes audio decoder with provided configuration.

methods.name: InitializeVideoDecoder
methods.description: Initializes video decoder with provided configuration.

methods.name: OnBufferDecrypted
methods.description: Callback when a buffer has been decrypted.

methods.name: OnBufferRead
methods.description: Callback when a buffer has been read.

methods.name: OnAudioDecoded
methods.description: Callback when audio buffers have been decoded.

methods.name: OnVideoDecoded
methods.description: Callback when video has been decoded.

methods.name: OnConnectionError
methods.description: Handles connection errors with the Mojo decryptor.

methods.name: GetWriter
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate MojoDecoderBufferWriter based on stream type.
